name: Stripe's Webform Integration
description: Provides a stripe webform element and default handlers.
project_description:
This is a webform integration using the Stripe module allowing to use a credit card element and add a submission handler to collect charges/subscriptions.

 It's a nice implementation showcase of the Stripe module on D8, flexible enough for general donations/event registrations.

 Versions 
 2.0.0+ 
 Version 2.x requires Stripe 2.0.0+ module. There's no upgrade path between the two versions. You will likely need to reconfigure your webform element and submit handler. 

 NOTE: [#2959413]

 Some settings remains the same.

 Version 2.0 makeover was sponsored by The Council of Canadians .

 8.x-1.0+ 
 Version 1.x only works with Stripe 8.x-1.0.
